ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   B. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   D. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

8. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.
   B. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Relations with people of other faiths and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Corruption 04 7 History of Islam 7.1 Battle of Badr and Uhud 04 7.2 Treaty of Hu and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Corruption and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Battle of Badr and Uhud 04 7.2 Treaty of Hudaybiya 03 7.3 Conquest of Makkah 07  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
